newsitem.title: USA: Discovery Technologies closes ZuZu chain.
newsitem.headline: Discovery Technologies closes ZuZu chain.

text.p: Discovery Technologies Inc said it closed its ZuZu Handmade Mexican Food restaurants and both its president and chief executive officer resigned, effective immediately.
The company did not name replacements for David Hill, its president and chief executive D. William Hill.
Officials were not immediately available to comment.
The company said it closed ZuZu's five restaurants because it needed additional financing to buy 17 Arby's units in southern Colorado, according to terms of a May agreement.
A Discovery Technologies spokesman said the company has not yet bought the Arby's restaurants.
It still hopes to do so, he added.
